751-3286-3499.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2226-4415-5921.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-4415-5921.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Fractured Realm.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Stonecloaker by paying its mana cost.
When Stonecloaker enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

141-7446-8095.easyPrerequisites: There's a nonland permanent card in your graveyard.
141-7446-8095.description:
Cast Moment of Reckoning by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Moment of Reckoning.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Moment of Reckoning
Resolve the Moment of Reckoning copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

728-1981-2415-2842.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Blood Artist and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

5233-6798-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Boros Garrison.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Boros Garrison from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boros Garrison enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

1887-2021-2060-3334.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

4399-4518-4716-6626.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Prosperous Innkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Prosperous Innkeeper trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4518-4716-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1619-2921-4605-5542-6139.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2921-4605-5542-6139.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Caves of Chaos Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Caves of Chaos Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Caves of Chaos Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Caves of Chaos Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Caves of Chaos Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Caves of Chaos Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Caves of Chaos Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2921-4605-5542-6139.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1619-4050-4605-5542-6150.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6150.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Tomb of Horrors Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Tomb of Horrors Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Tomb of Horrors Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Tomb of Horrors Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Tomb of Horrors Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6150.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

670-1619-3991-6138.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-3991-6138.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Bloodboil Sorcerer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, it triggers, returning Bloodboil Sorcerer from exile to the battlefield.
When Bloodboil Sorcerer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Bloodboil Sorcerer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Bloodboil Sorcerer.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Faceless Butcher.
Repeat from step 5.

1322-3259-7603.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that has base power 0.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-3259-7603.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Primo.
Resolve the Primo trigger, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the damage dealt.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Fractal token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control except Donatello

3259-3480-7291.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control an artifact creature.
3259-3480-7291.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Donatello and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Donatello and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact creature.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

95-6590.description: Cast Overture by paying its mana cost, causing an opponent to mill a number of cards equal to half their library, rounded down, times two due to Bruvac.
95-6590.notes: If the targeted opponent has an odd number of cards in their library, they will have one card remaining. If they have an even number, they will mill their entire library.

628-4050-7189.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dread Tiller.
When Dread Tiller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dread Tiller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2438-5571-7046--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4508-5880-7040.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

147-1638-2060-6260.description:
Cast Quandrix Command by paying its mana cost, choosing its first and third modes.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Quandrix Command, with the copy's first mode targeting Dualcaster Mage and the copy's third mode targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the copy of Quandrix Command, returning Dualcaster Mage from the battlefield to your hand and putting three +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Caradora.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-5010-5231-5708.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Cast Golgari Thug from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

3305-3817-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing Body Launderer to connive.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

518-1534-6191.notablePrerequisites:
Bloodthirsty Conqueror has indestructible.
You control another indestructible creature.
You have a way to deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
518-1534-6191.description:
Cast Arcbond by paying {2}{R}, targeting Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Holding priority, cast Twincast by paying its mana cost, copying Arcbond, with the copy targeting another indestructible creature you control.
Resolve both Arcbonds.
Deal damage to Bloodthirsty Conqueror.
Arbond triggers, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to the other indestructible creature being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers for each opponent dealt damage, and Arcbond triggers due to Bloodthirsty Conqueror being dealt damage.
Resolve all Bloodthirsty Conqueror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Arcbond trigger, dealing that much damage to each player and each other creature.
Repeat form step 6.

5016-6758.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn.
5016-6758.notablePrerequisites: Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
5016-6758.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. Dawnsire triggers, dealing 100 damage to  Spitemare.
Spitemare triggers, dealing 100 damage to any target

2105-3609-6750.notablePrerequisites: Inspirit has one or more charge counters on it.
2105-3609-6750.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Inspirit triggers, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Declare Combat Celebrant as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. Combat Celebrant triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your second combat phase. At the beginning of the combat phase, Inspirit triggers, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

252-2073-2511--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, putting the noncreature artifact from your graveyard onto the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur creature due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the artifact returned in step 1.
When the artifact dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

1020-3689-4985-6518.description:
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

38-2420-6461.notablePrerequisites: Scuzzback Marauders does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
38-2420-6461.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Scuzzback Marauders, adding {R}.
When Scuzzback Marauders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Scuzzback Marauders enters the battlefield, Warden of the Grove triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scuzzback Marauders
Repeat.

2034-2043-4365-5446.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Esika's Chariot.
When the Esika's Chariots enter the battlefield, their first abilities trigger, creating eight 2/2 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.
2034-2043-4365-5446.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other artifact(s) with Urza's ability.

771-1980-2276-5990-6229.notablePrerequisites:
Tetsuo has an Equipment attached to it with mana value 5 or greater.
Tetsuo does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Relearn or Said must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
771-1980-2276-5990-6229.description:
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Savage Beating without paying its mana cost, choosing its second mode.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Savage Beating.
Resolve both Savage Beatings, causing you to get two additional combat phases after this one.
Move to your first combat phase.
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Relearn without paying its mana cost, targeting Said.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Relearn, targeting Savage Beating.
Resolve both Relearns, causing you to return Said and Savage Beating from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second combat phase.
Repeat steps 1 through 4 one additional time.
Declare Tetsuo as an attacker. Tetsuo triggers, causing you to cast Said without paying its mana cost, targeting Relearn.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Said, targeting Savage Beating.
Resolve both Saids, causing you to return Relearn and Savage Beating from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your second combat phase, and repeat from step 1.

5342-5460.description:
Cast Rush of Dread by paying {3}{B}{B}, causing an opponent to lose at least their entire life total due to Bloodletter of Aclazotz.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

198-1620-4067.notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least four charge counters on it.
198-1620-4067.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding Bestial Bloodline, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Activate Bestial Bloodline by paying {4}{G}, returning it to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other permanent(s) using Mind over Matter.

643-2060-3525-4772-5121.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Urtet.
Urtet does not have summoning sickness.
It is your turn.
643-2060-3525-4772-5121.description:
Activate Urtet by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} and tapping it, putting six +1/+1 counters on each creature you control, as they are all Myrs due to Maskwood Nexus.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Urtet.
Repeat.

3525-4203-4249.notablePrerequisites:
Harmonious Emergence and Pemmin's Aura attached to Nykthos.
Your devotion to blue is at least four.
3525-4203-4249.description:
Activate Nykthos' second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Nykthos.
Repeat.

486-1978-2625-4659-4768.notablePrerequisites: Kibo does not have summoning sickness.
486-1978-2625-4659-4768.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's second ability by tapping it, causing Kibo to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Kibo by tapping it, causing each player to create a Banana artifact token.
When the Banana enters the battlefield, Altar of the Brood triggers, causing each opponent to mill a card.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Banana, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Kibo.
Repeat from step 2.

84-2972-3750.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least six Dragons that can attack this turn.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
84-2972-3750.description:
Declare six Dragons you control as attackers.
Utvara Hellkite triggers six times, creating six 6/6 Dragon creature tokens.
The Dragons enter the battlefield, triggering Ganax six times, creating six Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five Treasure tokens you control by tapping and sacrificing them, adding at least {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

1846-1987-2493-2499.description:
Cast High Tide.
Tap the Island for {U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker targeting Archaeomancer and the Island.
Archaeomancer triggers twice, returning Ghostly Flicker and High Tide from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast High Tide.
Tap the Island for {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker targeting Archaeomancer and the Island.
Archaeomancer triggers twice, returning Ghostly Flicker and High Tide from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast High Tide.
Tap the island for {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Repeat, gaining mana each itteration.

6-215-527-864.notablePrerequisites:
Selvala does not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature with power eight or greater.
6-215-527-864.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{G}{G}{G}{G} to your mana pool.
Cast Vitalize by paying {G}, untapping all creatures you control.
Cast Eternal Witness by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Vitalize from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Eternal Witness from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
